observations: A wide-open mouth dominates the lower center, rendered in looping black lines with white marks suggesting teeth against a dark interior.
Dense yellow scribble lines spread across the cheeks and chin, layered over olive and red color fills, while a broad-brimmed dark hat sits across the upper head.
Two arms extend toward the upper corners against the teal background, fingers spread, framing the face with thin scratchy strokes in ochre and red.
reading: The face pushes forward, mouth thrown open and arms flung wide, so the whole composition reads as a single outward thrust. Yellow scribble lines spread across the cheeks like static. The dark hat presses down while the arms pull up and out, setting those two forces against each other. The teal field is marked with loose horizontal strokes that keep the background from fully receding.
contextAngle: Within the owned numbered subset, this work sits between nnxyz #43 and nnxyz #64 by title order, not confirmed creation order. The collector links nnxyz work to scrimshaw through dense line-over-color patterning. The teal field echoes nnxyz nnotb #197 from a separate owned collection.

connections.reason: Both works center a head with a wide-open mouth and dense yellow scribble lines radiating from the face, but #43 uses a saturated red field while #48 uses teal, shifting the feeling between the two.
nnxyz nnotb #197 shares the same flat teal background and open-mouth forms, but spreads multiple figures loosely across the field rather than focusing tightly on a single face.

lookingQuestion: Where does your eye settle first — on the dark opening of the mouth, the spreading yellow lines across the cheeks, or the hands at the edges — and what does that path through the image do to how you read the whole?
